text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka had shown the world her true strength
with a magnificent runaway victory in her debut race, but—

Unbothered by the public uproar, she
was out training today with a calm, composed face.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Phew... Trainer. I've finished cooling down.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Good work out there.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You seem to be in good shape, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Air Groove.
Are you in the middle of training?

(Air Groove—a proud Umamusume
who strives to be the ideal "Empress" of all Umamusume.)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well, something like that.
More importantly—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I was watching your debut race from the stands the other day.
You've transformed into something truly incredible."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen you run with such complete freedom.
...It was almost terrifying.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Running unburdened by anything
really does suit you best after all."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. It made me realize
I don't need to overthink unnecessary things.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I was told that as long as I keep running forward and forward...
I'll definitely reach the place I want to go..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Through and through,
you really are an outrageous Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, the Twinkle Series isn't that
easy, either. Even you will face hardships.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This is a place where everyone comes with hungry eyes,
ready to snatch victory away.
Don't let your guard down.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer. It depends on your skill as well.
Whatever you do, do not waste Suzuka's talent."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... At least your answer wasn't bad.
Well then, sorry for bothering you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, see you later, Air Groove.

With the Twinkle Series about to begin...
I renewed my resolve to support her all the way to the end!

—That night. In the bustling dorm cafeteria,
Silence Suzuka was eating her meal
quietly all by herself.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah. It's Silence Suzuka-san.
I hear she's pretty amazing, huh~

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Still, she's so cool...
Doesn't that make her a little hard to approach...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah! Suzuka-san!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Spe-chan. Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I have huge news!

Special Week's arrival instantly livened up
the quiet dinner table.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
They were showing footage of Suzuka-san's
debut race at the shopping district today!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: She's always wonderful, of course, but Suzuka-sanduring a race is just, well—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It was so sparkly and dazzling……!
I was just completely glued to it……!

She had been eating quietly, but after a moment
of dumbfounded shock—she started giggling.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...! 
Oh, Spe-chan, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Once the Twinkle Series starts, they'll be playing a whole lot more, right~?
I can't wait~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! Come to think of it, I bought some
strawberry daifuku from the shopping district afterwards♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Would you like to eat together later!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Yes,
fufu.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? D-Did I say
something weird!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, not really, but...
You sure are busy, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Ah, I'm sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: No. ...Could I have that strawberry daifuku later?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...!
Yes! Of course...!
The conversation continued breezily after that—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Special Week really is
something else, isn't she...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Right... Her communication skills...
I really can't tell if they're good or bad...
—She had secretly become the center of attention!
